liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It's All Over Now Baby Blue** (1 review): Listener calls this version their favorite, noting the performer's intense delivery [9]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): Brent's organ solo is highlighted as a standout performance moment [10]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Features trippy, Bralove-inspired sound effects and Jerry Garcia's Dark Star territory [11]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Described as zooming the listener past the twilight zone [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd88-12-28 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd88-12-28 t02 Iko Iko**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd88-12-28 t03 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd88-12-28 t04 Jack-A-Roe**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd88-12-28 t05 It's All Over Now**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd88-12-28 t06 When Push Comes To Shove**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd88-12-28 t07 Memphis Blues Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd88-12-28 t08 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-12-28.141658.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 153 min [1]
- **gd88-12-28.sbd-matrix.3914.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Mix is well-balanced, though the listener wishes for more bass presence [13]
- **gd1988-12-28.149731.ultramatrix.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 154 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1988-12-28.149778.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 154 min [5]
- **gd1988-12-28.nak100.holtz.97099.flac16**: audience recording; 19 songs; 149 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Described as a very good recording, with seamless disc changes and phase-adjusted patches [7]

## Around the show

- Attendee stood near the barrier, close to Brent and Jerry, describing a religious experience [14]
- A fan named Margot correctly predicted Jack Straw would end the first set [14]
- Jerry Garcia reportedly spoke to a non-fan friend through his guitar during Bird Song [16]
- No rain occurred, unlike the previous year, allowing for a nice California break [18]
- Only three shows were held during the New Year's run due to scheduling [18]
- Attendee found a laminant at Long Beach and used it to record this show [19]
- Iko Iko is considered more appealing than the Long Beach version [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-12-28.141658.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Ted Mattes' (with an assist to Jeff Travitz) Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK4 > Sony PCM-F1 with Apogee filters; Transfer Info: PCM… [1]
- **gd88-12-28.sbd-matrix.3914.sbeok.shnf**: source: Healy Mix (SBD+AKG C 424b mic)> PCM> DAT> EventGina> WAV> CD> EAC> SHN [2]. Also: Listener initially worried about the Healy mix balance before hearing it [13]
- **gd1988-12-28.149731.ultramatrix.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 29, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [4]
- **gd1988-12-28.149778.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 29, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [5]
- **gd1988-12-28.nak100.holtz.97099.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by Brion Green and SirMick; source: aud > Nak CM-100's with CP-4 shotgun mics > D-5 > mac [7]. Also: Tape flip after When Push crossfaded; applause pause after Turn On crossfaded [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA - 12/28/1988 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-12-28-1988/) [22]
